passage:
consensus — 共识；一致意见
The committee met once a month and made all decisions by consensus.

downturn — 衰退；下降
The local council cut its small annual grant, and donations fell during a national economic downturn.

controversial — 有争议的
These changes were controversial.

advisory — 顾问的；咨询的
This shift from full control to an advisory role was difficult for some members, but most accepted it because the library survived.

hybrid — 混合的
It hired a part-time digital coordinator, expanded its online collection, and began offering hybrid events that people could attend in person or online.

paradox — 悖论；矛盾的现象
That is the paradox of institutional continuity: sometimes you must change in order to stay the same.

preserve — 保护；维持
The library changed its structure to preserve its purpose.

adapt — 适应；调整
In fact, the ability to adapt while preserving core values is what allows institutions to survive over time.
